description: This header defines the `absl::Cleanup` class template, which implements scope guard idiom for executing cleanup callbacks upon scope exit. It includes methods for canceling or invoking the callback early, and provides type deduction utilities for creating cleanup objects.

classes.name: absl::Cleanup
classes.description: A class template implementing scope-based cleanup with methods to cancel or invoke the callback.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Prevents the cleanup callback from executing.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Executes the cleanup callback early and prevents it from executing in the destructor.
